primitives.name: Frame-to-Detection Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: Endpoints: `GET /health` (open; Vercel scheduler warm-pings it every 3 min in game windows) and `POST /process-frame` (multipart JPEG ≤2 MB, ~720p; fields game_id/ts/fps/burst/homography; returns detections, tracklets, derived metrics as JSON).
primitives.assumptions: Input frames are preprocessed to 640px width with person class only, confidence threshold fixed at 0.35.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Frame size exceeds 2MB or resolution below 640px.

layer2.mapping: Detection map is isomorphic to a set-valued function over spatial coordinates with temporal indexing.
layer2.telemetry: Detections count per frame and bounding box coordinates.

primitives.name: GPU Acceleration Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Auto-uses CUDA when present, silently falls back to CPU when not.
primitives.assumptions: CUDA runtime environment is available or fallback behavior is defined.
primitives.breakdown_regime: No GPU hardware detected or CUDA driver unavailable.

layer2.mapping: Kernel selects compute backend based on availability, enabling dynamic resource allocation.
layer2.telemetry: Compute backend used per execution cycle.

primitives.name: Tracker State Eviction
primitives.verbatim_quote: - State: 100% in-process memory (per-game tracker dict, 6 h idle eviction).
primitives.assumptions: State is fully ephemeral and evicted after 6 hours of inactivity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System restart or timeout triggers full state wipe.

layer2.mapping: Memory-based state management with time-bound lifecycle.
layer2.telemetry: Active tracker count and eviction timestamps.
